scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind find information on a page.
Search engine: helps find pages about a topic. Search words: describe what information is needed.
Source: is where information comes from. Check evidence: helps judge whether information is reliable. Bookmark: saves a link for later.
Use an imaginary example or a teacher-approved offline screenshot. Discuss when to use search engine and search words. Never enter a real password or share private details in this activity.
